items.title: Chester Jones Interview, 1961-07-10
items.q: I do remember him saying Thomas Coleman That's the bass player I played with him too

ctx.x: Kid he's going big in New York I don't remember him On that call I don't remember him so Oh we never did really get back to We get wandering off Never did get about your family Did your father or mother

Yeah well my father He played the cornet I hear him talk about it a lot of the time So he played B flat cornet He used to go to Xavier's school Up here on St. Charles Street That's where he was He finished school at You know He had a little outfit down to cut off They used to play with the band They played with down there Him and I had a cousin by the name of Albert He was a I think Albert was playing trombone He don't talk too much about it Because he's a person Maybe every once in a while He'd talk about it But…
